E.abstract.conclusion_sentence.value: In this state-month analysis of routine HMIS data from India, 2012–2020, the results were not consistent with lower use of essential services during the El Niño phase; not consistent with more reported diarrhoea in children under 5 years during the El Niño phase; and consistent with lower service use in state-months with more heatwave days or a rainfall deficit (institutional deliveries).
